entries.question: I need course of medical doctor and fee
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU) offers various medical courses. The primary course to become a medical doctor is the Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS).

Here is the information regarding the MBBS course and related fees:

**Course:** MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery)

**Duration:** 5 years + 1 year compulsory rotating internship.

**Admission:** Admissions are made through the UP state Combined Pre Medical Test and through the All India Medical Entrance Examination conducted by CBSE. There are also seats reserved for Government of India nominees.

**Fees:**
The examination fee for the MBBS course is Rs. 12,000/- per examination (for both regular and supplementary).

For detailed information on admission criteria and other fees, please refer to the KGMU website:
*   **Courses and Admissions:** [https://kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)
*   **Examination Fee Details:** [https://kgmu.org/exam_fee.php](https://kgmu.org/exam_fee.php)

If you have any more specific questions about the admission process or other courses, feel free to ask!

entries.question: What can I do if all slots has been booked is displaying in cardiology for Monday?
entries.answer:
If all slots for Cardiology appointments on Monday are booked, you have a few options:

*   **Check for other available days:** You can try booking an appointment for a different day of the week.
*   **Check the official KGMU website for OPD information:** The KGMU website (www.kgmu.org) provides details on OPD services. You might find information there about how to manage fully booked slots or alternative ways to seek an appointment.
*   **Contact the OPD directly:** You can try calling the provided OPD contact numbers: 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333 to inquire about any cancellations or alternative appointment procedures.
*   **Consider the SMS option:** You can try sending an SMS with "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to 8887019134 to see if that yields a different result or provides information on waiting lists.

entries.question: अगर सभी स्लॉट बुक दिखा रहा है तो क्या करें
entries.answer:
यदि सभी स्लॉट बुक दिखा रहा है, तो आप निम्न कार्य कर सकते हैं:

1.  **नियमित रूप से जांच करें:** कभी-कभी कुछ स्लॉट रद्द हो जाते हैं। इसलिए, नियमित रूप से वेबसाइट या ऐप की जांच करते रहें।
2.  **अलग-अलग समय पर प्रयास करें:** हो सकता है कि कुछ विशेष समय पर स्लॉट उपलब्ध हों।
3.  **हेल्पलाइन पर संपर्क करें:** आप KGMU की हेल्पलाइन पर कॉल करके स्लॉट उपलब्धता के बारे में जानकारी ले सकते हैं। KGMU के हेल्पलाइन नंबर हैं: 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333।
4.  **SMS के माध्यम से प्रयास करें:** आप "APPOINTMENT <आपका नाम>" लिखकर 8887019134 पर SMS भेजकर भी अपॉइंटमेंट का प्रयास कर सकते हैं।
5.  **ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन पोर्टल (ors.gov.in) पर देखें:** यह पोर्टल भी अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए एक विकल्प है।

धैर्य रखें और इन विकल्पों को आजमाते रहें, आपको जल्द ही स्लॉट मिल जाएगा।

entries.question: क्या प्रक्रिया है इसकी
entries.answer:
To pursue a B.Sc. in Optometry at King George's Medical University (KGMU), you will typically need to follow these steps:

1.  **Check Eligibility Criteria:** Visit the KGMU website for the specific eligibility requirements for the B.Sc. Optometry program. This usually includes educational qualifications (e.g., 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology).

2.  **Admission Process:** KGMU usually admits students to paramedical courses through an entrance examination. You will need to apply for this entrance exam when applications are open.

3.  **Entrance Examination:** Prepare for and appear for the KGMU entrance examination for paramedical courses.

4.  **Counselling and Seat Allotment:** Based on your performance in the entrance examination, you will be called for counselling. During counselling, you can choose your preferred course and college, and seats will be allotted based on your rank and availability.

5.  **Admission and Document Verification:** Once a seat is allotted, you will need to complete the admission formalities, which include document verification and fee payment.

**Where to find specific details:**

*   **KGMU Website:** The most accurate and up-to-date information regarding the admission process, eligibility criteria, important dates, and application forms will be available on the official KGMU website.
    *   **Paramedical Admission Information:** [https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php](https://kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php)
    *   **Courses Available:** [https://kgmu.org/paramedical_course.php](https://kgmu.org/paramedical_course.php)

It is highly recommended to regularly check the KGMU website for any announcements or updates regarding the admission process for the B.Sc. Optometry program.
